meta.description: Decoded remarks/mode columns of CEA Daily Coal Stock Report (latest date in sqlite coal_plants_daily; company codes unioned over all dates present), all plants in sqlite coal_plants_daily.

legend.LDG Port: stock lying at the LOADING port (east-coast port where domestic coal railed from mines is loaded onto coastal vessels: Paradip, Visakhapatnam, Gangavaram, Haldia, Dhamra). Interpretation: 'LDG' = loading; the report itself gives no legend - see notes.
legend.UL Port: stock at the UNLOADING (discharge) port near the plant, e.g. Kamarajar/Ennore or V.O. Chidambaranar (Tuticorin) for TN, Krishnapatnam for AP coastal plants.
legend.TT: thousand tonnes (per report note 'TT- Thousands Tonnes')
legend.caveat: ITPCL (100% imported coal) is shown with 'Stock: LDG Port: 100 TT' on some days and 'Stock: UL Port: 100 TT' on others, so the labels are not applied consistently for every plant.

meta.interpretation_note: The brief suggested LDG=Kamarajar/Ennore and UL=V.O.C. port. That does not fit the data: AP plants (Dr NTTPS Vijayawada, RTPP) and ITPCL (imported coal, Cuddalore) also carry 'LDG Port' stocks, and Rayalaseema TPS has no link to Ennore. Read literally as Loading/Unloading port (standard shipping abbreviations LDG/DISCH, UL=unloading), which matches the RAIL-SEA mode of the plants concerned. Treat as interpretation (unconfirmed by a CEA legend).

mode_legend.RAIL-SEA: rail-sea (coal railed to an east-coast loading port, shipped coastwise, then conveyor/rail to plant)
mode_legend.RAIL-SEA- RAIL: rail-sea-rail (RSR: rail to loading port, coastal ship to unloading port, rail to inland plant)
mode_legend.RAIL-SEA- ROAD: rail-sea-road (rail to loading port, ship, road from unloading port)
